name: web-bridge-setup
description: Create your own private Web-Bridge Site and plugin from bundled source, then connect the Windows, macOS, or Linux companion.

interface.longDescription: An explicitly invoked setup workflow that creates an account-owned private Web-Bridge Site and its canonical MCP plugin. Includes portable source and cross-platform companion code. Requires Sites and a build-capable environment for initial setup; installation alone does not deploy anything.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create my own private Web-Bridge instance using the bundled source, fresh account-owned Site identity and new secrets.
